title: Protein Kinase C-delta Inhibitor Peptide Formulation using Gold Nanoparticles
protocol: Retrieve peptides P2, P4, and PKCδi from the -20°C freezer.
Thaw peptides at room temperature with the bottle closed.
Weigh 0.01 g of each peptide on a microscale.
Transfer each peptide to a separate 50 mL conical tube.
Add 18.74 mL of deionized water to the P2 tube.
Add 16.93 mL of deionized water to the P4 tube.
Add 8.21 mL of 50% acetonitrile diluted in deionized water to the PKCδi tube.
Vortex each peptide solution briefly.
Place the conical tubes in a sonicator for 5 minutes at 40 MHz.
Transfer solutions to a biosafety cabinet (BSC).
Add 1 mL of each 1 mM peptide solution to new 50 mL conical tubes.
Dilute P2 and P4 with 19 mL deionized water, PKCδi with 19 mL 50% acetonitrile in the respective tubes.
Mix solutions thoroughly.
Transfer 475 μL of P2 solution to a 15 mL tube.
Add 25 μL of P4 solution to the same 15 mL tube.
Add 500 μL of PKCδi solution to the 15 mL tube.
Add 9 mL of 20 nm GNP solution (7.0x10^11 particles/mL) to the 15 mL tube containing peptides.
Wrap the 15 mL tube with aluminum foil.
Shake overnight at room temperature.
Transfer GNPs/PKC peptides to a biosafety cabinet.
Aliquot 1 mL of GNP/PKCi mixture into each 1.5 mL microtube.
Centrifuge tubes in a microcentrifuge for 30 minutes at 15,294 x g at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant from each tube under a biosafety cabinet.
Re-suspend the pellet in the desired solvent according to the concentration required.
Mix the desired solvent well before diluting the GNP/PKCi pellet.
Pour 0.5 mL of GNP/PKCi solution into an acryl cuvette.
Place the acryl cuvette on a UV-Vis spectrophotometer.
Test the peak absorption of the GNP/PKCi solution.
